title: Fix CI: resolve pnpm version mismatch in workflow files
body:
All CI workflows fail at the `pnpm/action-setup@v4` step due to conflicting pnpm versions: `10.28.1` hardcoded in workflows vs `10.31.0` in `package.json#packageManager`.

- Removed explicit `version: 10.28.1` from `pnpm/action-setup@v4` in `ci.yml`, `lint.yml`, `pr-automation.yml`, and `validate-deps.yml`
- The action auto-reads from `packageManager` in `package.json`, keeping a single source of truth
